releases.notes: Landscape layout on phones: tabs on the left, panels side by side. Android Auto: Trip avg is this trip's average from 0.5 km (CAL before), range estimate when parked. Kia EV2 AC charging details; charging now recognised on Megane E-Tech 60, eVito 100 and Leapmotor B10. MG IM5 battery and DC charging power. e-GMP 12 V SoC shows CAL while calibrating. Mini Cooper SE speed, odometer, range. Removed wrong values: MG4 64/77 odometer, EV3/EV4 81 motor temp, IM5 speed.

Drive tab is now "Dashboard". Safety: Service scans skip the brake/airbag units on the Geely EX2 and ESC/EPB on VW Group plug-ins. Fixed: MEB/e-Golf/e-up isolation (x10), MEB torque and CO2, Mach-E cell max/delta, XPeng outdoor temp, Tesla S/X regen shown as charging, Model 3 capacity. New: Leaf on more adapters + motor/cabin temps, Geely EX2 battery data, e-GMP miles odometer, Galaxy E5 and BMW 330e cells, more All Sensors values.

Fix: stationary scans and the Pre-purchase Check no longer disconnect with "Adapter supply voltage could not be verified" at a healthy voltage. Safety: Generic OBD2 skips control units the car's safety profile blocks; Geely EX2 39.4/40.8 listen-only with SoC. Fullscreen Drive panels, adapter test "Passive CAN capabilities". Cars: Tesla 3/Y capacity, Leaf power and dash SoC, Zoe VIN/tyres/motor temp + 50 values, Outlander PHEV cells, Evoque/E-Pace P300e.

Kia Niro EV 64.8: ECU scan and fault codes disabled after reports of a shift to neutral; safer clearing of fault codes (read first, erase only units with codes); car info dialog; arrival SoC on the Drive SOC tile during navigation; live stream no longer loses data; demo mode and connection fixes; about 3,100 more texts translated. Cars: BMW iX3, Volt/Ampera Gen1 SoH, Mach-E DC power, Geely SEA charging, Ariya, e-Boxer, Elroq, C-HR+, XPeng P7+.

Fix for Hyundai/Kia readings through a BLE ELM327 v1.4 clone (wrong SoC, power, temperatures); 96 more cars get a full profile instead of Generic OBD2; Berlingo/Partner Electric on the i-MiEV profile; BMS remaining energy on Kona/e-Niro/e-Soul/Ioniq; side-menu Demo mode starts the full demo; Car Commands translated into all languages. Cars: BMW cells, Ford hybrids, Nissan Ariya AC charging, Spring/Zoe/smart 12 V, Jaguar coolant, Hongqi, Leapmotor B10.

Drives recorded by the M5 adapter are collected automatically, S3XY Commander limited to Tesla Model 3/Y, cell tests keep their verdict after switch-off, pre-purchase scan no longer cancelled by garage GPS drift, 12 V charge estimate on more cars, revised Chinese translation. Cars: Jaguar I-Pace, Audi e-tron 12 V, BMW battery temperature, MEB cell SoH, Nissan Leaf doors, Toyota 2026, smart 453, Renault Scenic AC charging.

12 V battery protection on by default: evDash disconnects below 11.5 V or when the adapter cannot report its voltage (Settings, can be switched off). New: demo mode on a recorded Ioniq 6, charge and low-battery SoC alarms, pre-purchase health score, range at the recent pace, charging card OF MAX % and rated power, 12 V / DC-DC verdict, offline charger tiles. Fixes: E-GMP 12 V/DC-DC currents, Leaf 40 SoC, Volvo/Polestar DC charging, STLA Medium cells, charge report energy after a link gap.

Android Auto: Extra large tiles are back, pages no longer lose a tile, and guidance posts turn notifications to the car screen. Tesla Model 3/Y motor temperature shows the motor; Tesla Model S/X SoC no longer freezes at 96.4 %. New readings: BMW Gen5 SoC from the cluster, BMW plug-in hybrid ignition, BYD cabin temperature and motor torque, Volvo/Polestar speed, XPeng G6/G9 DC voltage limit, Ford Courier gear, Mazda CX-60 PHEV 13 to 23 values. Toyota hybrid 12 V fixed. MG4 motor speed read removed as a precaution.

CarPlay: new tile size setting (Large/Medium/Small) for the Driving and Charging screens. BYD Atto 3 split into Standard Range and Extended Range - please re-pick your car. Pre-purchase: a full LFP pack no longer reads as unbalanced. VW e-Up: the 18.7 kWh pack is detected from the car. Kona 64 kWh: AC and DC charging told apart. Honda HR-V e:HEV: gear letter back as an approximation. Hongqi E-HS3 separated from the E-QM5 decode. Chinese and catalog polish; MEB preheat wording.

BMW i3/i3s: all 96 cells in the Cells screen (auto-scan) and in the pre-purchase check. BMW plug-in hybrids: cell SoC min/max/avg, cell OCV and capacity. MINI Aceman E/SE: first profile (pack voltage). Honda HR-V e:HEV: no more guessed gear letter. MEB preheat: clearer wording, park + open hood. Chinese adapter test incl. PDF font. iOS map: charger naming and clusters; Android: new navigation dialogs.

Renault Zoe ZE50 charging detected; Renault 5 DC fast charge. Peugeot/Citroën/Opel/DS/Alfa odometer. VW ID. road consumption; e-Golf 24.2 charger + temperatures. Mercedes EQC odometer + cell temps; Audi Q8/SQ8 motor data; Kona/Niro 12 V + LDC. Android: navigation follows the car's night mode, new phone-map controls.

Android: Google Maps navigation replaces OSM in the Map tab (Places search, alternative routes with arrival SoC, chargers, EV panel; also Android Auto). AA display settings apply on first click. Classic Kona/Ioniq: AC no longer shown as DC. MG/SAIC: 5 more battery registers. Tesla cable hint. New: Tesla Model S 60, Dacia Spring 24.3.

E-GMP live loop steadier (~7 s). Hybrid fuel avg/range fix; trip energy kept across reconnects; XPeng report and aux-battery fixes. New data: e-Golf VIN, KGM Musso EV, BAW Pony, Wuling Bingo, Subaru Trailseeker. New China/VinFast catalog entries.

CarPlay map: no snap-back, bigger zoom, alt routes, charger outlet counts, animations, head-unit nav. E-GMP shows CONDITIONING instead of a minute of OFF. Smart EQ (453): speed+odometer. Tesla Classic S/X: RPM/range/temp. New: Toyota Century, Crown Estate PHEV.
Honda e pack capacity shown. Mercedes eVito: odometer + more accurate SoH. Hongqi E-HS3: fixed wrong cell count. Smart EQ (453): tyre pressure shown. E-GMP: ~40% faster live refresh.
Honda e DC fast charging recognized. BAW Pony 13.7 kWh first real battery data. Follow-up to 935.
iOS toolchain fixes, Geely SEA platform sweep. First official public GitHub release of evDash.
